checks.code: const m = await module('game/course.js'); const [a, b] = [m.COURSE[1], m.COURSE[2]]; return Math.abs(m.progressOf(m.COURSE, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2) - 1.5) < 0.01;

checks.code: const s = window.course.state; const half = Math.floor(s.progress) ; const C = (await module('game/course.js')).COURSE; const mid = C[Math.floor(C.length / 2)]; s.car.x = mid[0]; s.car.y = mid[1]; s.car.speed = 0; await wait(100); const last = C[C.length - 1]; s.car.x = last[0] * 0.2 + C[0][0] * 0.8; s.car.y = last[1] * 0.2 + C[0][1] * 0.8; await wait(100); s.car.x = C[0][0]; s.car.y = C[0][1] - 5; await wait(100); return s.lapTimes.length === 1;
